utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN
utterances.text:
And I've had enough of him trying to
exploit me and take advantage of me. He

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN
utterances.text:
took my affections, he used them for his
gain, and then he threw me away like an

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN
utterances.text: old shoe.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN
utterances.text: I've had it!

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN
utterances.text: I don't care if he lives or if he dies.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN
utterances.text: I just want him to get that.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN
utterances.text:
or no, Judge, that was vicious,
sadistic, cruel, dirty, rotten... Slimy?

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN
utterances.text: Synonyms are my life.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN
utterances.text: Bye.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN
utterances.text:
Miss Sullivan, do you have any idea what
you just said to me?

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN
utterances.text: Yes, sir, I do.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN
utterances.text: Well, you're right.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN
utterances.text: Oh, yes. So am I.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN
utterances.text: I thought you said Leon had to go.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN
utterances.text: He wouldn't have gotten 25 feet.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN
utterances.text:
Mac, call security downstairs. Tell the
boys at the door they can go.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN
utterances.text: My pleasure, sir.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN
utterances.text: Excuse me, sir. What's going on?

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN
utterances.text: Leon wasn't going anywhere.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN
utterances.text:
The minute Mrs. Lund told me he was in
New York, I had security seal off this

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN
utterances.text:
building. He could get in, but there was
no way he was going to get out.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN
utterances.text: You mean you lied to me?

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN
utterances.text: Of course.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN
utterances.text: I'm an adult.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN
utterances.text:
Sometimes adults have to do a lot of
things that they don't really want to

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN
utterances.text: Like lie?

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN
utterances.text: If it comes to that.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN
utterances.text: Even though they don't want to.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN
utterances.text:
Just like they don't want to have to
instill fear into a young, beautiful,

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN
utterances.text: innocent mind.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN
utterances.text: But sometimes they got to.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN
utterances.text:
Because a kid's got to learn sooner than
later.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN
utterances.text:
that there are bad people out there that
don't cherish them and love them the

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN
utterances.text: way that we do.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN
utterances.text: You need somebody, Leon.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN
utterances.text:
When you left me the last time, I hurt
real bad.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN
utterances.text:
And nobody, not even you, is ever going
to put me through that again.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN
utterances.text:
You mean you'd hunt me down like a dog
if I ran out of here?

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN
utterances.text:
I'd tie you with a leather strap and
feed you with a tube if I had to.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN
utterances.text: I love you too, Harry.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN
utterances.text: Oh.

utterances.text: You okay, big guy?

utterances.text:

utterances.text:

utterances.text: Bull.
